findings.claim: A bare pnpm totem falls through to pnpm's shim lookup, which once opened a cmd banner; pnpm exec does not.
findings.counterexample: REFUTED at pnpm 11.2.2 source (corepack dist/pnpm.mjs): fallbackCommand 'run' (255794) routes an unknown name through the run handler, which on no matching script calls the exec handler (215843, handler39 = 'pnpm exec', 216125-216160) with the same prependPaths (216204) and spawn; on Windows both forms run totem.CMD under cmd.exe /q /d /s /c via cross-spawn, which cannot print the interactive banner. Folded on all three surfaces: the sentence now states the fallback order (builtin, declared script, then exec), keeps 'once' and 'not reproduced since', and adds the installed-package node path.
